label: Local MCP Server
title: Local MCP Server
subtitle: Wraps a locally-running stdio-based MCP server and exposes its tools to agents. The server runs as a subprocess managed by InnoviumAI.
whenToUse: Used automatically when you have installed a local MCP integration. The tools from the MCP server appear as agent capabilities without any additional configuration.

methods.name: (dynamic)
methods.description: Methods are determined by the MCP server's tool manifest and vary per server. Each tool the server exposes becomes a callable method.

mediaCaption: A local MCP server tool call showing the server name, the method called, and the result returned
